sell.title: Sell your maal on {brand}
sell.sub: List what you have, with quantity and location. Buyers find you and send enquiries. Free, no commission.

sell.step1.body: Pick the commodity, type, quantity, unit and your city. Add photos if you have them.

sell.step2.body: Sign in with your mobile number and a one-time code. Add your business name and contact preferences.

sell.loginNote: You will be asked to sign in with your mobile number before publishing.

seller.noBusinessBody: Buyers see your business name, city and the commodities you supply. It takes about two minutes. You can add listings right after.
biz.title: Business profile
biz.sub: This is what buyers see on your public supplier page. Contact details are shown only if you allow it below.
biz.name: Business name
biz.showPhone: Show my business phone on my public profile and listings
biz.privacyNote: If you keep these off, buyers can still reach you by sending an enquiry through the platform. Identity documents are never shown publicly.
biz.commoditiesHint: Search and tick all that apply. Buyer requests for these commodities will be shown to you.
verify.title: Supplier verification
verify.sub: Verification shows buyers exactly what was checked. Documents are private and seen only by verification reviewers.
verify.check1: Phone verified: your mobile number was confirmed by one-time code.
verify.check2: Business documents reviewed: a reviewer checked documents such as NTN, STRN, registration or a utility bill in the business name.
verify.check3: Admin verified: documents reviewed and an admin additionally confirmed the business by phone or visit.
verify.retention: Documents are kept only as long as needed for verification and legal requirements, then deleted.
verify.docsHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to {size} MB each. Upload at least one.
verify.submitted: Verification request submitted. A reviewer will check your documents and you will get a notification with the result.
verify.openRequest: You already have an open verification request.
wizard.notListed: Not listed — I will type it
wizard.customReview: Custom names are shown on your listing and sent to our team to add to the list.

wizard.titleHint: Short and clear, e.g. “Super Basmati, 5% broken, Lahore”.
wizard.priceType: How do you want to show the price?
wizard.price.negotiableSub: Show a rate but allow bargaining.
wizard.price.quoteSub: Buyers ask and you reply with a rate.
wizard.price.on_contactSub: No rate shown; buyers call you.
wizard.descriptionHint: Quality, origin, packing, delivery terms. Do not include phone numbers here — use the contact settings instead.
wizard.documentsHint: Lab reports, safety data sheets, registration certificates (PDF/JPG/PNG).

wizard.contactPhone: Show business phone ({phone}) on this listing

wizard.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
wizard.maxPhotos: You can add up to {max} photos.

mylist.title: My listings

mylist.publishedBody: Buyers can now find it. Keep it fresh by refreshing it every few weeks.
mylist.draftBody: Your draft is not visible to buyers. Open it to finish and submit.
mylist.rejectedBody: This listing was not approved. Read the reason, edit it and submit again.
